summary.result: The comparison of normalized hydraulic head loss rates showed that the cross section of sea dike embankment was homogeneous approximately and the width of cross section was long enough to blocking tide water.
summary.background: In this study the process of normalizing hydraulic head loss rate was developed for the purpose of estimation of seepage blocking state at each seepage segment in sea dike embankment.
summary.method: Pore water pressure sensors were installed with some interval along seepage path, then the hydraulic head loss rate at each segment between pore water pressure sensors was calculated, and then the calculated hydraulic head loss rate was normalized based on seepage path length.

summary_ko.method: 간극수압 센서는 침투 경로에 일정 간격으로 설치하였다. 이때 간극수압 센서 사이 각 구간의 수두손실률을 계산하여, 침투 경로 길이에 따라 계산된 수두손실률을 정규화하였다.
